ingredients.name: Sodium Benzoate
ingredients.why_used: Used to inhibit the growth of certain bacteria, yeast, and fungi, extending shelf life.
ingredients.regulatory_info: Approved for use in foods by FSSAI and major food safety authorities within specified limits.
ingredients.considerations: Generally recognized as safe at permitted levels. May form benzene when combined with ascorbic acid (vitamin C) under certain conditions, but levels in food are typically very low.

ingredients.name: Maltodextrin
ingredients.why_used: A processed carbohydrate used for texture, bulk, or to improve mouthfeel in powdered and packaged foods.
ingredients.regulatory_info: Approved food additive within permitted limits.
ingredients.considerations: High glycemic index; may affect blood sugar more than table sugar in some people. Not inherently harmful at normal consumption levels.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.why_used: Provides sweetness and can act as a preservative and texture modifier.
ingredients.regulatory_info: Ordinary food ingredient; no special additive limits.
ingredients.considerations: Excess intake is linked to weight gain, dental caries, and metabolic issues. Context and portion size matter.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.why_used: Enhances taste and helps preserve food.
ingredients.considerations: High sodium intake is associated with increased blood pressure in some individuals.

ingredients.name: Monosodium Glutamate
ingredients.regulatory_info: Approved flavour enhancer (INS 621 / E621) within permitted limits.
ingredients.considerations: Generally recognized as safe. A small subset of people may be sensitive to high doses.

ingredients.name: Citric Acid
ingredients.why_used: Adds tartness and acts as a preservative and antioxidant.
ingredients.considerations: Generally recognized as safe. Found naturally in citrus fruits.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Oil
ingredients.why_used: Provides fat content, texture, and carries fat-soluble flavours.
ingredients.considerations: Type of oil (palm, sunflower, soybean) affects saturated/unsaturated fat profile.

ingredients.name: Milk Solids
ingredients.why_used: Adds dairy flavour, protein, and body to products.

ingredients.name: Wheat Flour
ingredients.why_used: Provides structure and bulk in baked and extruded products.

ingredients.name: Aspartame
ingredients.why_used: Provides intense sweetness with negligible calories.
ingredients.regulatory_info: Approved intense sweetener (INS 951 / E951) within permitted limits.
ingredients.considerations: People with phenylketonuria (PKU) must avoid it because it contains phenylalanine.

ingredients.name: Artificial Colour (INS 102)
ingredients.why_used: Adds yellow colour to make food more visually appealing.
ingredients.regulatory_info: Approved food colour (INS 102 / E102) within permitted limits. Some countries require warning labels about possible effects on children's activity and attention.
ingredients.considerations: May cause hypersensitivity reactions in some individuals. Some regulatory bodies require advisory labelling.
ingredients.alternative_names: E102, INS 102, FD&C Yellow No. 5, Tartrazine
